capabilities: search Bible references typed in English, Korean, Chinese, Japanese or added translations' book names
insert passages from several translations at once as callouts, blockquotes or plain text
add translations from HelloAO, bolls.life codes, licensed JSON files or Accordance modules (Mac)
fill in text under a reference already written in the note
add copyright notices, long-quotation warnings and Logos/Accordance deep links
extras: Accordance text fetching works only on macOS with the Obsidian desktop app; ESV requires a free Crossway API key and NET requires no key; developer accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee; README is bilingual (English and Korean).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a Bible reference and insert the text from one or more translations, in many languages, into a note.

relations.evidence: Accordance (Mac): pull text from Bible modules you own in Accordance
Logos offers no official way for other apps to read Bible text

summary: Bible reference search that inserts passages from many translations into notes, with multilingual book names, copyright notices and Logos/Accordance links.
